description: Implement append-only evidence schemas, audit entries, integrity checkpoints, source normalization, claims, reconciliation, findings lifecycle, and typed compensation registry for @counter/evidence package.
steps: Step 1 - Update packages/evidence/package.json: Add dependencies on @counter/domain (workspace:0.1.0) and @counter/trust-protocol (workspace:0.1.0). Add fast-check 4.0.0 to devDependencies.
Step 2 - Create packages/evidence/src/types.ts: Define all core types and enumerations.
Step 3 - Create packages/evidence/src/source-authority.ts: Implement source authority rules.
Step 4 - Create packages/evidence/src/evidence-store.ts: Implement an in-memory append-only evidence store.
Step 5 - Create packages/evidence/src/audit.ts: Implement audit entry creation and integrity checkpoints.
Step 6 - Create packages/evidence/src/normalization.ts: Implement source normalization.
Step 7 - Create packages/evidence/src/reconciliation.ts: Implement reconciliation functions.
Step 8 - Create packages/evidence/src/finding-lifecycle.ts: Implement finding status transitions.
Step 9 - Create packages/evidence/src/compensation-registry.ts: Implement typed compensation registry.
Step 10 - Update packages/evidence/src/index.ts: Export everything from the new modules.
Step 11 - Create packages/evidence/src/types.test.ts: Test type guards, enum completeness.
Step 14 - Create packages/evidence/src/audit.test.ts: Test audit and integrity chain.
Step 16 - Create packages/evidence/src/finding-lifecycle.test.ts: Test finding status transitions.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter @counter/evidence typecheck passes with no type errors
EvidenceRecord is immutable - no mutation methods exist on the store
Agent claims are never treated as authoritative for payment/order/fulfillment truth
Tampering detection works: modified entries between checkpoints cause digest mismatch
Reconciliation produces typed findings for all 10 finding types
Finding lifecycle enforces valid status transitions
Compensation checks prerequisites before execution and returns prerequisite_failed on failure
All tests exercise real logic and would fail if implementation were reverted
findings: Used npm_config_engine_strict=false to bypass node engine version mismatch (22.14.0 expected vs 22.23.2 installed). createCanonicalError always uses the definition message not custom message - tests must assert on error.code rather than error.message content.
